# CMS-SNF-100 — Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage

**Policy version:** 2025-10-01

> Condensed, paraphrased excerpt used as a test fixture. It is written in the shape of a real
> coverage manual so the extractor is exercised against prose rather than a pre-structured form.
> It is not a verbatim reproduction of any published CMS manual.

## § 30.1 Scope

This section governs coverage of post-acute extended care furnished in a skilled nursing facility
following a qualifying inpatient hospital stay. Coverage determinations under this section are made
against the conditions in §§ 30.2 through 30.6.

## § 30.2 Medical necessity

Extended care services are covered only where the services are reasonable and necessary for the
diagnosis or treatment of the beneficiary's condition. A determination that services are not
medically necessary is a sufficient basis for denial, and no other condition of this section may
substitute for it.

## § 30.3 Skilled level of care

The beneficiary must require skilled nursing or skilled rehabilitation services that, as a practical
matter, can only be provided on an inpatient basis. Care that consists solely of personal care,
custodial supervision, or assistance with activities of daily living does not meet the skilled level
of care required by this section.

## § 30.6 Benefit period limitation

A beneficiary is entitled to no more than 100 covered days of extended care services in a single
benefit period. The days already used in the benefit period, taken together with the days now
requested, may not exceed that 100-day maximum. A request that would carry the beneficiary past the
maximum is not covered as to the excess days.

## § 30.9 Effect of the conditions

The conditions in §§ 30.2, 30.3 and 30.6 are cumulative. Coverage is approved only where every one
of them is met; failure of any single condition requires denial as to the services affected.
